mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers economic distress signals, prompting risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe economic contraction, causing risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL signals persistent inflation, prompting further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises during monetary tightening, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates significant manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During demand-driven expansions (RSAFS > 600,000 million dollars), a month-over-month increase in CPIAUCSL signals economic overheating, prompting policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises during demand-driven expansions, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
